mira-chen: async check-in — quick roundup (what I did / blockers / today)

mira-chen: did: ran terraform plan for staging IAM drift, found 2 unexpected service-account grants.
mira-chen: blocker: need approval for a one-off vendor IAM grant (read-only) to `analytics-vendor-sa` — unsure about tag/scoping requirements.

alexis: ack — can you paste the requested policy snippet here? also which environment (prod/staging)? :eyes:

mira-chen: staging only for now. snippet below (trying to keep minimal):
```json
{
  "Effect": "Allow",
  "Action": ["storage.objects.get"],
  "Resource": ["arn:aws:s3:::redwood-audit-evidence/*"]
}
```

dan_k: quick thought — prefer using temporary STS session with `aws:RequestTag` requirement rather than permanent SA grant. If vendor tooling can't do STS, we can create a short-lived role and tag it.

jamie: did: triaged the vuln flagged by Snyk on `libsec` — appears to be a false positive because we only use a subset of the API. opened PR #4123 with a unit test and explanation for the SCC.

mira-chen: thanks. can you drop the PR link? I'll include in the audit packet.

jamie: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sec-infra/pull/4123 — includes test + comment for auditor. deploy-bot: CI ✅ (staging) :thumbsup:

sec-bot: note: KMS key `kms-audit-staging` rotation dry-run completed at 2026-03-17T09:02Z. No policy conflicts detected.

- confirmation of SOC2 access log retention config (S3 lifecycle + Glacier vault id)
- codeowners approval for PR #4110 (IAM hygiene cleanup)
- answer to auditor question about vendor SA justification (one paragraph)

alexis: I can confirm the S3 lifecycle tag; Glacier vault id is `gv-87a1`. I'll add a short paragraph for the vendor justification in the thread and ping legal.

alexis: on it — will review in the next 30m.

jamie: will do after the vuln test merges.

mira-chen: thanks team. quick checklist for today:

- merge #4123 and #4110 (jamie, alexis)
- convert vendor grant to short-lived role + tag enforcement (dan_k)
- upload final audit packet to secure-share and DM compliance (mira-chen)
